# SecretAgent

## Summary

A fictional test-only class, not part of the real SPDX 3 model.

## Description

SecretAgent exists solely to exercise class-hierarchy behaviour
(e.g. subclass-of-Agent subsumption checks) in SpecMD's own test suite.

Its name is deliberately unlike any real SPDX 3 term so it cannot be mistaken
for one.

## Metadata

- name: SecretAgent
- subClassOf: Agent
